`/Users/krish/Desktop/study/project/upay-trackly-isolated`

- GitHub: `git@github.com:Krishpotanwar/upay-trackly-isolated.git`
- Upstream: `https://github.com/Shlok-Dwivedi/Trackly.git` (as `upstream` remote)

**Why:** The original `/Users/krish/Desktop/study/project/UPAY/` was reset to upstream (Shlok-Dwivedi/Trackly) clean state. All UPAY work lives in `upay-trackly-isolated`.
React 18 + TypeScript + Vite 5 (SWC), Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Firebase Firestore (no Supabase for events), Flask backend, Capacitor for mobile.

- TASK 0 — Rebrand Trackly → UPAY: ✅
- TASK 1 — EventSummaryPanel slide-over drawer in Reports: ✅
- TASK 2 — Committee Management (CommitteeManager, CommitteeSelect, src/lib/committees.ts, src/hooks/useCommittees.ts, integrated in Users.tsx): ✅
- TASK 3 — Committee assignment in EventCreate + committee enrollment in EventDetail: ✅
- TASK 4 — Seed script at backend/scripts/seed_events.py: ✅
- TASK 5 — CSV Export (Export CSV button in Reports.tsx, downloadCSV() function): ✅
- BONUS — Performance I

- Enrollment data is embedded in FirestoreEvent docs (`assignedTo[]`, `attendees[]`) — no separate collection
- `attendees[].joinType` = `'assigned' | 'enrolled'` distinguishes staff-assigned vs self-enrolled
- `attendees[].committeeId/committeeName` added during enrollment
- Time is IST throughout — utility functions in `src/lib/utils.ts`: `toIST()`, `formatInIST()`, `nowInIST()`, `todayInIST()`
- Reports uses `useEvents` hook (Firestore onSnapshot), not a one-time getDocs

Key KPIs confirmed by industry: participation rate, completion rate, volunteer engagement rate, retention, recurring attendance %. CSV → Power BI via Blob download (max 30k rows). Heatmaps and time-series line charts are most effective for volunteer analytics.

**Why:** Validates current implementation choices.
